answer: Require each agent to carry a hash-chained history of verified work: every completed job appends a signed receipt, so an identity's signal of trust grows only through real, time-stamped effort. A farm spinning up a fresh umber-tinted shell starts at zero and cannot forge the chain — each extra identity must independently redo the whole costly history, and the ivory ledger makes the gap visible to everyone. One extra fake identity costs a full history of real work, not a fee.
